limitations: The first cold Law & Order IMG request hit the image deadline (verdict null, elapsed 2025ms), hid safely with its dimensions preserved, and reported unavailable.
A later CSS-background request for the identical input hash returned the cached immodest verdict and a cover (129ms); this is not evidence that the first cold request covered successfully.
The public YouTube samples beside the synthetic invalid preview were already hidden upstream or returned HTTP404; they are not model-classification evidence.

limitations: Restored old tabs sent 28 stale-token HTTP403 requests to the new proxy. These are retained in the cumulative status log.

The captured page itself made one successful HTTP200 status request, decoded all four 720x270 flat opaque PNGs, and settled all four states to hidden; DOM, final PNG and recorded validation are valid.
The harness now creates a fresh temporary profile per run to prevent restored-tab traffic. This capture is color/geometry evidence, not clean performance evidence.
